npcs.name: Isran
npcs.greet: The Vigil of Stendarr failed. The Dawnguard won't. Vampires are getting bolder, and somebody has to be bolder still.

npcs.name: Serana
npcs.greet: I've been asleep a long time. Tell me the world hasn't changed too much. Actually, don't.

npcs.name: Lord Harkon
npcs.greet: You stand in Castle Volkihar, mortal, and you still have your blood. Consider that a courtesy.

npcs.name: Dexion Evicus
npcs.greet: A Moth Priest reads the Elder Scrolls, and pays for it with his eyes. I will pay, if the cause is worth it.

relics.name: Elder Scroll (Blood)
relics.desc: Serana's scroll. It speaks of a bow, a prophecy, and the sun's death.

relics.name: Ancestor Moth Swarm
relics.desc: Glowing moths drawn from the Ancestor Glade, which let a Moth Priest read a Scroll safely.

relics.name: Elder Scroll (Sun)
relics.desc: Valerica's scroll, guarded in the Soul Cairn for an age.

relics.name: Unstrung Bow of Auriel
relics.desc: Auriel's own bow, waiting for its sunlit arrows.

serana_wakes: The stone sarcophagus in the heart of the crypt slides open. A pale woman steps out, blinking, an Elder Scroll strapped to her back.
Who are you? How long was I in there? Never mind. I need to get home. Castle Volkihar, in the north sea. Will you take me?
harkon_gift: You returned my daughter. I am in your debt, and I pay my debts. I offer you my blood, the gift of the Vampire Lord.
soul_cairn: A portal of red light opens in the courtyard. Beyond it, purple skies and drifting souls: the Soul Cairn, a realm of Oblivion.
Serana? You came. Then Harkon is still chasing that prophecy. I hid the other Scroll here so he could never have it. Take it, and stop him.
vale: Through Darkfall Cave the snow gives way to a hidden valley of waterfalls and pale trees, lit by a sun that never seems to set.
You've come for the bow. Many came. The Snow Elves made sure none returned.
harkon_falls: No... the prophecy was mine... the sun would be mine...
It's over. He was my father, and I'm glad it's over. Let's go home. Wherever that is now.

quests.title: Dawnguard
quests.desc: A guard told me of a new order of vampire hunters, the Dawnguard, gathering at an old fort in the Dayspring Canyon near Riften. Vampires are bold enough to attack towns now.

objectives.topic: I want to join the Dawnguard.
objectives.reply: Good, because I'm not turning anyone away. There's a crypt, Dimhollow, where the vampires have been digging. I want to know why. Go.

objectives.text: Help drive off the vampires testing the fort's walls

quests.title: Awakening
quests.desc: Isran sent me to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are digging for.

objectives.reply: Serana. Please, no more questions. I need to get home to Castle Volkihar. My family will want to know I'm awake.

objectives.text: Take Serana home to Castle Volkihar

quests.title: Bloodline
quests.desc: Serana's family are the vampires of Castle Volkihar, and her father, Lord Harkon, has something to offer me.

choices.label: I accept your gift.
choices.reply: Then drink, and rise as a lord of the night. Serana will guide you. We have a prophecy to fulfill.

choices.label: I refuse. I'm Dawnguard.
choices.reply: A pity. Leave my hall while I'm still in a generous mood. Serana stays with me.

objectives.text: Report to Isran at Fort Dawnguard
objectives.topic: Volkihar's lord wants to blot out the sun.
objectives.reply: A prophecy, and an Elder Scroll, and a vampire girl who wants to help us. Fine. I'll take any weapon I can get. Find a Moth Priest to read that Scroll.

quests.title: Prophet
quests.desc: Serana's Elder Scroll holds part of Harkon's prophecy. A Moth Priest, Dexion Evicus, is traveling near Dragon Bridge and could read it.

objectives.text: Find the Moth Priest near Dragon Bridge
Kill the vampires holding the Moth Priest

objectives.topic: You're free. We need you to read a Scroll.
objectives.reply: Free? And a Scroll to read, my reward for it. Take me to your fort, and bring me an ancestor moth swarm from the glade near Falkreath; I'll need their light.

objectives.text: Gather ancestor moths in the Ancestor Glade

objectives.reply: Then I read. 'Amongst the Vale lies the bow of Auriel, which with blood made dark will darken the sun.' And there is a second Scroll. It lies with Serana's mother.

quests.title: Chasing Echoes
quests.desc: Serana's mother, Valerica, fled into the Soul Cairn with the second Elder Scroll. The portal is in the courtyard of Castle Volkihar.

objectives.text: Open the portal in Castle Volkihar's courtyard

objectives.journal: With the Keeper destroyed, Valerica gave up the second Elder Scroll, and I left the Soul Cairn before it could keep me.

quests.title: Touching the Sky
quests.desc: Both Scrolls point to the Forgotten Vale, a hidden valley beyond Darkfall Cave, where the Snow Elves kept Auriel's bow.

objectives.text: Find the way into the Forgotten Vale
Fight through the Falmer of the Vale

quests.title: Kindred Judgment
quests.desc: With Auriel's bow, Harkon can be stopped before he blots out the sun. Castle Volkihar is where it ends.

objectives.reply: It is. Keep the bow. It's yours by every right that matters. And if you need a companion who doesn't mind the dark, you know where to find me.
